classification.difficultyReason: The three parts are scaffolded in sequence and use only a linear function. Part a needs substitution of x+h with a bracket expansion and a sign change. Part b subtracts f(x), where the 4 and -3x cancel. Part c divides by h and notes h≠0. These are routine linked procedures with no strategy choice. The hardest demand is symbolic substitution with algebraic simplification. That is a little more abstract than the numeric evaluate-and-solve parts of p12-q8. It is simpler than p12-q7, which needs quadratic factorisation and solving.
